intro: Ancestral voices, field recordings and electronic bass.
healing_text:
There is a contemplative side of NAOBA: sound as medicine. 

From the wild soundscapes recordings I make slow ambient journeys for meditation and rest, shaped by what I perceive in nature, study in psychoacoustics, and informed on how our body and brain answer to sound by my own experience. Thus creating the voices of living ecosystems that speak back to our emotional, mental, energetic bodies. 

Close your eyes, breathe, and let the Earth tune you back.
